description:
Cast Slaughter-Priest of Mogis by paying {0} due to Ragemonger.
When Slaughter-Priest of Mogis enters the battlefield, Sethron and Cloudstone Curio trigger.
Resolve the Cloudstone Curio trigger, choosing to return nothing to your hand.
Resolve the Sethron trigger, creating a 2/3 Minotaur creature token.
When the Minotaur token enters the battlefield, Cloudstone Curio triggers, returning Slaughter-Priest of Mogis to your hand from the battlefield.
Repeat.
